title: Reset GAUL to UN Geodata 2023
summary: GAUL's polygons and lines date from the 2018 UN Geodata, so they are reset to the 2023 versions. Each border that changed since 2018 is listed with the land between the two lines.

title: Fix known UN Geodata errors
summary: These are factual errors in UN Geodata 2023, so the new GAUL corrects them.

title: Bring back disputed areas
summary: GAUL lists some disputed areas as their own entities, but UN Geodata dissolves them into neighbouring entities. They stay separate here, so each can be kept or dissolved later.

title: Islands
summary: Whole islands are attributed to GAUL entities after the cuts. Where the sources differ, the new GAUL keeps GAUL's ownership. GAUL land with no UN land is recorded, including the Viet Nam islands in the South China Sea.

title: Islands with no GAUL polygon
summary: GAUL never drew these islands, so its Voronoi cells give them to a neighbouring entity. The new GAUL keeps the UN Geodata owner.
